summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Kornit Digital Ltd., a foreign private issuer, furnishing a press release and slide presentation for its first quarter 2026 earnings results. The filing reports total revenues of $48.5 million, trailing twelve-month impressions growth of approximately 12%, and a 103% increase in AIC revenues. It highlights positive operating cash flow for the tenth consecutive quarter and growing customer response to the Atlas MATRIX system. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or abrupt management change is mentioned. The filing is a standard earnings release with no corporate event triggering a special-situations classification.
